name: Wind
overview: Scripture portrays wind as a powerful and purposeful force used by God to accomplish His will. The east wind is depicted as blasting and destructive, as seen in Genesis 41:6 and Job 27:21, illustrating God's judgment and control over nature. Conversely, the west wind is shown as a mighty agent of deliverance, removing the plague of locusts from Egypt (Exodus 10:19). Winds also symbolize divine intervention and judgment, such as the blast sent against enemies in 2 Kings 19:7, and the tempestuous forces described in Job 37:9 reveal God's sovereign control over all directions and elements.
